avoid_supplements.name: Ephedra/Ma Huang
avoid_supplements.mechanism: Sympathomimetic activity counteracts labetalol's antihypertensive effects and may cause hypertensive crisis
avoid_supplements.action: Contraindicated; counsel patient to avoid completely

avoid_supplements.name: Yohimbine
avoid_supplements.mechanism: Alpha-adrenergic agonist that opposes labetalol's mechanism of action, reducing efficacy and increasing BP
avoid_supplements.action: Avoid concurrent use; recommend alternative supplements

avoid_supplements.name: Licorice (high doses >3g/day)
avoid_supplements.mechanism: Mineralocorticoid-like effects promote sodium retention and potassium depletion, worsening hypertension and reducing labetalol efficacy
avoid_supplements.action: Limit licorice intake; monitor blood pressure and electrolytes if used

caution_supplements.name: Ginseng
caution_supplements.mechanism: May have mild sympathomimetic effects potentially reducing antihypertensive efficacy
caution_supplements.action: Monitor blood pressure; use moderate doses only

caution_supplements.name: Caffeine supplements
caution_supplements.mechanism: Stimulant effects may modestly counteract labetalol's antihypertensive benefits
caution_supplements.action: Limit high-dose caffeine intake; monitor response

caution_supplements.name: CoQ10
caution_supplements.mechanism: May have mild blood pressure-lowering effects; potential for additive hypotension
caution_supplements.action: Monitor blood pressure; dose adjustment of labetalol may be needed

avoid_foods.name: Tyramine-rich foods (with concurrent MAOIs or in excessive amounts)
avoid_foods.mechanism: While labetalol is not an MAOI, excessive tyramine may trigger sympathomimetic response that could oppose antihypertensive action
avoid_foods.action: Moderate intake of aged cheeses, cured meats, fermented foods; counsel patient

caution_foods.name: High-sodium foods
caution_foods.mechanism: Excess sodium intake reduces antihypertensive efficacy and may increase fluid retention
caution_foods.action: Counsel on DASH diet and sodium restriction (<2300mg/day)

caution_foods.name: Licorice-containing foods/candies
caution_foods.mechanism: Excessive consumption may cause sodium retention and hypokalemia, reducing drug efficacy
caution_foods.action: Limit intake; encourage awareness of hidden licorice in processed foods

monitoring_notes: Monitor blood pressure regularly as interactions may reduce labetalol efficacy. Counsel on avoiding sympathomimetic supplements and maintaining adequate potassium intake, as labetalol use carries hypokalemia risk with concurrent supplements affecting sodium-potassium balance.
